libOverrides.source-storybook.mjs: Storybook 10 replaced index.json with manifests/components.json; component IDs encode the old title in lowercase kebab form; stories are nested under components not flat; yarn storybook build replaces npx storybook build (Yarn Berry PnP, no node_modules/.bin/)
libOverrides.dts.mjs: package has no root '.' export/types field (subpath-only exports); projectFor's entry fallback must resolve against typesRoot (dist/types), not pkgDir
libOverrides.story-imports.mjs: repo source uses Node imports-field subpath aliases (#src/*, #.storybook/*) that Vite resolves leniently but esbuild's strict Node-imports resolution rejects (pre-resolve # specifiers); kebab-case source dirs vs PascalCase/ancestor-prefixed exports broke the component-source redirect heuristic (toPascal + ancestor-prefix fallback); stories use CSF v4 factories (preview.meta()/.story()) needing a functional definePreview stub; @linaria/core+react's runtime guard throws when style helpers/compound subcomponents bundle from source (functional css/styled/cx runtime stub); 214+ files import icons via vite-plugin-svgr's './foo.svg?react' convention (a real component, not a URL) which the default dataurl loader breaks (real onLoad plugin parsing the SVG into a functional component)
libOverrides.preview-gen-storybook.mjs: CSF4-factory stories already fully merge meta+story decorators in story-imports.mjs's CSF4_FACTORY_STUB (mergeArr, inherited-first/own-last through .extend() chains); the base COMPOSE re-concatenated meta.decorators a second time, duplicating them and misordering .extend()-added decorators — fixed by using st.decorators alone when present. Also wires ctx.globals.backgrounds through (was hardcoded {}) via a per-cell wrapping div using this repo's own .storybook/preview.tsx light/dark palette, since several stories share one grid page (not isolated iframes) so document.body can't be touched. Also merges argTypes PER KEY instead of per-object, so a story overriding one field (typically {control:false}, to hide a control) doesn't drop that key's inherited mapping (hit Badge/SectionMessage/SplitButton's Variants-style stories, which rendered literal control strings as content). Also honors parameters.layout==='centered' with a centering flex wrapper (Storybook wraps centered-layout stories in a non-stretching container; without it Tooltip's width:100%-styled trigger stretches to fill the grid cell) — the first version of this wrapper was still insufficient (a single flex div has no intrinsic width of its own, so a percentage-width child still filled the grid cell); fixed by nesting an inline-flex shrink-to-fit div inside the centering div.
libOverrides.css-fallback.mjs: dist/js/style.css ships both new FormLayout’s layered display:flex and deprecated FormLayout’s unlayered display:grid for .el-form-layout — unlayered always wins per CSS cascade. Fork appends an unlayered .el-form-layout{display:flex} override after cssEntry to restore correct behaviour.
